units.source_text: 藤壶皇后自从桐壶帝让位之后，便与普通宫人一般日夜侍候帝居。

en.t: After Emperor Kiritsubo abdicated, Empress Fujitsubo served day and night at the retired emperor's residence just like an ordinary palace attendant.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后越发妒忌于她，索性常住儿子朱雀帝宫中。

en.t: The Kokiden Empress Dowager grew even more jealous of her, and in the end simply took up permanent residence in the palace of her son, Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后无人对敌，倒很安心。

en.t: With no one left to oppose her, Empress Fujitsubo was actually quite at ease.

units.source_text: 每逢春秋佳日，桐壶院[\[2\]](#part1338.html#m2)必举办盛大的管弦之会，声闻朝野。

en.t: Whenever a fine day came in spring or autumn, Kiritsubo-in[\[2\]](#part1338.html#m2) would hold a grand concert of flutes and strings, and its fame spread through court and country alike.

units.source_text: 让位以来，悠闲自得，甚是幸福。

en.t: Since his abdication, he had lived at leisure and in contentment, and was very happy.

units.source_text: 只有一事不能称心：冷泉院皇太子别居宫中，不得常常见面，未免悬念。

en.t: Only one thing failed to satisfy him: Crown Prince Reizei lived apart in the palace, so he could not see him often, and this naturally left him anxious.

units.source_text: 这太子没有后援人，上皇甚是担心，便命令源氏大将做他的保护者。

en.t: Because this crown prince had no one to support him, the retired emperor was deeply worried and ordered General Genji to act as his protector.

units.source_text: 源氏大将受命之时，一则以惧，一则以喜。

en.t: When General Genji received the command, he felt both fear and joy.
